import os
import sys


def main():
    src = "./data/five.txt"
    dst_dir = "./out"
    dst = "./out/answer.txt"

    size = os.path.getsize(src)

    os.makedirs(dst_dir, exist_ok=True)
    with open(dst, "w", encoding="ascii", newline="\n") as f:
        f.write(str(size) + "\n")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
